create_VAEBottleneck: create a VAEBottleneck module with configurable input_dim and codebook_dim for VAE latent space projection
run_VAEBottleneck_forward: run the VAEBottleneck forward pass to sample latents and compute KL divergence from input tensor z
review_VAEBottleneck_vae_sample: review the VAEBottleneck _vae_sample method that performs reparameterization sampling using mean and scale
build_VAEBottleneck_in_proj: build a VAEBottleneck with NormConv1d in_proj that splits input into mean and scale projections
test_VAEBottleneck_kl_loss: test the VAEBottleneck forward pass to verify KL divergence loss computation and latent sampling
